entities.name: Captain Cook's Pacific Voyages
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Three voyages mapped the Pacific, charted New Zealand and Australia, and searched for the Southern Continent. Cook carried Harrison's chronometer, proving longitude could be measured at sea.
